directory.name: World Pizza
directory.note: All-vegetarian pizza shop that has served the Chinatown-International District since reopening at this King Street location in 2011, after starting in Belltown in the 1990s.

directory.name: Sacro Bosco Pizza & Wine
directory.note: Pizza-and-wine service run by the Temple Pastries bakery team, known for massive crunchy-yet-airy Roman-style rectangles.

directory.name: Oxbow
directory.style: Bakery counter, offbeat whole pies and slices
directory.note: Sea Wolf-affiliated bakery and bagel shop that has also served whole pies and slices from noon to 5pm daily since opening in 2022.
